DESC001.说明: 原文数值与提取一致。但两篇 F/O 下降的原因相反：P609 把商用 1 M LiTFSI DOL/DME 换成 0.4 M LiFSI/DME，F/O 下降来自阴离子换成氟更少的 FSI 和盐浓度降低，作者归因于 FSI 更易还原、生成富 LiF 的稳定 SEI（K01、K02）；P510 的 DD（1 M LiTFSI DOL/DME）相对 NH（2.33 M LiTFSI DOL/正己烷）F/O 更低，来自不溶剂化的正己烷换回 DME、盐浓度降低，作者归因于多硫化物溶解与穿梭加重（Mshuttle）。另外 P510 两侧都不含 LiNO₃，P609 两侧都含 0.1 M LiNO₃。两篇机制不同、并不互相否定；这说明 F/O 一个描述符把“阴离子的氟”和“溶剂的氧”混在一起，单独用它判断方向不可靠。本条比的是全电池 CE：P609 循环平均 99.97% vs 99.91%（M0065）；P510 第 25 圈 45.16% vs 98.35%（M0075）。（AI 辅助复核，用户尚未逐项人工确认）
DESC001.可能原因: F/O 变化的来源不同（阴离子种类 vs 不溶剂化稀释剂）；LiNO₃ 有无不同；P510 无 LiNO₃ 时穿梭主导 CE
DESC001.机制线索: P609 K01、K02（FSI 生成富 LiF SEI）；P510 Mshuttle、MseiProtect（烃降低多硫化物溶解、保护负极）
DESC001.说明_en: Values match the source. But F/O falls for opposite reasons in the two papers. P609 replaces commercial 1 M LiTFSI in DOL/DME with 0.4 M LiFSI in DME: F/O drops because FSI carries fewer F atoms and the salt is more dilute; the authors credit FSI's easier reduction and a stable LiF-rich SEI (K01, K02). In P510, DD (1 M LiTFSI, DOL/DME) has lower F/O than NH (2.33 M LiTFSI, DOL/n-hexane) because the non-solvating hexane is replaced by DME and the salt is more dilute; the authors attribute DD's poorer behaviour to more polysulfide dissolution and shuttling (Mshuttle). P510 also has no LiNO₃ on either side, while P609 has 0.1 M LiNO₃ on both. The two mechanisms do not refute each other; the case shows that a single F/O descriptor mixes anion fluorine with solvent oxygen and is not a reliable design axis on its own. This item compares full-cell CE: P609 cycle-average 99.97% vs 99.91% (M0065); P510 cycle 25: 45.16% vs 98.35% (M0075). (AI-assisted review; not yet confirmed item by item by the user.)
DESC001.可能原因_en: Different sources of the F/O change (anion type vs non-solvating diluent); LiNO₃ present vs absent; shuttling dominates CE in P510 without LiNO₃
DESC001.机制线索_en: P609 K01, K02 (FSI forms a LiF-rich SEI); P510 Mshuttle, MseiProtect (hydrocarbon lowers polysulfide dissolution, protects the anode)

DESC003.说明: 不构成矛盾。P034 的 DH 含 50 vol% DMDS，DMDS 是有机硫共溶剂，本身参与反应、贡献容量；CH 去掉 DMDS 后 F/O 降低只是去掉了一个不含氧的活性共溶剂，性能下降来自活性物减少，不是溶剂化变化。且本条用的是“代表容量”（按硫＋碳＋粘结剂＋集流体＋电解液总质量，M0121），与 P609 的硫比容量定义不同。（AI 辅助复核，用户尚未逐项人工确认）
DESC003.可能原因: 有机硫共溶剂贡献容量；容量定义不同
DESC003.机制线索: P034 Mec_path（DMDS 先生成可溶 DMPS 中间体、走新反应路径）
DESC003.说明_en: Not a contradiction. P034's DH contains 50 vol% DMDS, an organosulfur co-solvent that reacts and contributes capacity itself. Removing it (CH) lowers F/O only because an oxygen-free active co-solvent is gone; the capacity drop comes from less active material, not from a solvation change. The metric is also the 'representative capacity' (normalised to S + carbon + binder + current collector + electrolyte mass, M0121), which differs from P609's sulfur-specific capacity. (AI-assisted review; not yet confirmed item by item by the user.)
DESC003.可能原因_en: Organosulfur co-solvent contributes capacity; different capacity definitions
DESC003.机制线索_en: P034 Mec_path (DMDS first forms soluble DMPS intermediates and follows a new reaction path)

SAME001.说明: 同一种改动（在 LiTFSI DOL/DME 中加 LiNO₃）首圈放电容量方向相反：P113 加 0.2 M LiNO₃ 后由 800 升到 900 mAh g⁻¹（M0109）；P668 在 1.6 M LiTFSI 中加 1 wt% LiNO₃ 后“初始放电容量稍降”（M0215，定性）。数值与原文一致。可能原因是放电截止电压不同：P113 截止 1.5 V，P668 截止 1.7–1.8 V；LiNO₃ 在约 1.6 V 以下被还原，会额外贡献一部分首圈放电容量，P113 的升高可能部分来自 LiNO₃ 自身还原。两篇都认为 LiNO₃ 明显抑制穿梭（M0106、M0215）。截止电压目前不在模型条件里，应补入。（AI 辅助复核，用户尚未逐项人工确认）
SAME001.可能原因: 放电截止电压不同（1.5 V vs 1.7–1.8 V）；P668 为定性“稍降”，幅度可能在误差内；盐浓度 1 M vs 1.6 M
SAME001.机制线索: 两篇都把 LiNO₃ 的作用归于抑制穿梭；首圈容量差异更可能来自 LiNO₃ 低电位还原
SAME001.说明_en: The same change (adding LiNO₃ to LiTFSI in DOL/DME) moves first-cycle discharge capacity in opposite directions: P113 rises from 800 to 900 mAh g⁻¹ with 0.2 M LiNO₃ (M0109); P668 reports a 'slight decrease in the initial discharge capacity' with 1 wt% LiNO₃ in 1.6 M LiTFSI (M0215, qualitative). Values match the source. A likely explanation is the discharge cut-off voltage: P113 discharges to 1.5 V, P668 to 1.7–1.8 V. LiNO₃ is reduced below about 1.6 V and adds capacity of its own in the first discharge, so part of P113's increase may come from LiNO₃ reduction. Both papers agree that LiNO₃ strongly suppresses the shuttle (M0106, M0215). The cut-off voltage is not yet a model condition and should be added. (AI-assisted review; not yet confirmed item by item by the user.)
SAME001.可能原因_en: Discharge cut-off voltage (1.5 V vs 1.7–1.8 V); P668's 'slight decrease' is qualitative and may be within noise; salt concentration 1 M vs 1.6 M
SAME001.机制线索_en: Both papers attribute LiNO₃'s role to shuttle suppression; the first-cycle difference more likely reflects low-potential LiNO₃ reduction
